descricao: In 1987, Level 22 was declared a small micronation, becoming independent of any other faction within the other levels of The Backrooms. From then on, the micronation within Level 22 continued to grow rapidly. By 1990, most entrances to Level 22 had been closed by its inhabitants, with this group officially isolating itself and giving itself the new title of "Emstable"1. While Emstable began negotiating trades with both the M.E.G. and the B.N.T.G. in 2012 and 2016 respectively, this independent faction would very rarely allow those who were not a part of their group into the level.
